description:
Muju connects people with local businesses through a conversational AI experience.

Users can discover nearby restaurants, explore local offerings, ask questions, receive recommendations, and complete actions such as placing pickup orders with participating businesses.

Muju helps local businesses make their products and services easier to discover by connecting their existing information, menus, and ordering systems to AI.

Our mission is to create a local connection layer where communities can easily find and support businesses around them.
